Some institutions set earlier dates of their own, and theirs is the one that binds. | Studielink closes at 23:59 on 1 May. panel.text: Deadlines & sessions | 15 November 2026, 23:59 PST | British Columbia — UBC International Scholars Program: apply and submit the award application | Hard deadline | Note | An expensive date to miss, and one that looks optional. UBC's largest awards for international students require the whole application two months before the ordinary deadline, in the first term of the final IB year. If you are not applying for the award, your date is 15 January. Award applicants also have to meet UBC's English standard and submit their documents by 31 January 2027. | Two months before UBC's general January deadline, and an easy date for an applicant in Denmark to miss: it is the date by which an international student must have applied to UBC and submitted the award application to be considered for the International Scholars Program. The scholarship is the reason the date exists, and the scholarship is the thing that is gone on 16 November — the general admission route stays open until 15 January. Published with a time and a time zone, 11:59 p.m. PST, which is 08:59 the following morning in Denmark; an applicant in Denmark working to a local midnight has until the morning of 16 November, but do not use that margin. | Source | 15 December 2026 | British Columbia — Simon Fraser University, Undergraduate Scholars Entrance Scholarship closes | Hard deadline | Note | Six weeks before Simon Fraser's own application deadline, which is the trap: a student who applies in January, on time, has already missed the entrance scholarship by a month. The supporting documents for the scholarship are due separately on 31 January 2027, and the offers go out between mid-March and May. | Source | 15 January 2027, 23:59 PST | British Columbia — UBC applications close | Hard deadline | Note | Pacific time is nine hours behind Denmark, so this closes on the morning of 16 January Danish time.
